title: Good-Order Fob Courtesy on the Security Deposit Account
content:
**Q. What is the good-order fob courtesy on a Security Deposit Account?**
A. A household that kept its lease in good order earns a fob courtesy, which is taken off the fob charge. Good order is read from two records on the Apartment Home Lease: whether recurring autopay is enrolled on the lease, and whether renter's insurance is on file.

- **55.00 USD** when recurring autopay is enrolled on the lease and renter's insurance is on file.
- **25.00 USD** when exactly one of the two holds.
- **None** when neither does.

**Q. How is it applied?**
A. The courtesy is taken off after the fobs are multiplied by the per-fob charge. The corrected fob charge never falls below 0, and it is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

### Truth table

| Autopay enrolled on the lease | Renter's insurance on file | Fob courtesy |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 55.00 |
| yes | no | 25.00 |
| no | yes | 25.00 |
| no | no | none |

### Hypothetical cases

- Fobs charged come to 150.00 USD and both records hold: the charge is 150.00 less 55.00, which is 95.00 USD.
- Fobs charged come to 37.50 USD and both records hold: 37.50 less 55.00 is below 0, so the charge is 0.00 USD.
